title: Mission and values
summary: Preparing responsible professionals for the maritime industry and advancing maritime science.

body.text: The university’s mission is to prepare highly qualified specialists for sea and inland transport, ensure navigational safety and conduct world-class research.
The university creates an environment where knowledge meets practice and graduates are ready for demanding professional work.
